display.title: Frontiers II - Hunt the Twilight Bosses
display.subtitle: First kills pay the biggest tokens
description: Each Tier 2 boss's FIRST kill grants a one-time bonus worth a large
chunk of the pool (15 each at T2); repeat kills grant a smaller amount,
so the lane stays farmable. All minted automatically on the kill.
Slay the gatekeepers of the Twilight Forest. Their kills also count
toward the Tier 2 boss rush, the combat road to Tier 3.
